name: Lobe Chat
description: An open-source, modern-design AI chat framework.
composeYaml:
services:
  lobe-chat:
    image: 'lobehub/lobe-chat:1.135.5'
    environment:
      - 'OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}'
      - 'OPENAI_PROXY_URL=${OPENAI_BASE_URL:-https://api.openai.com/v1}'
      - 'ACCESS_CODE=${ACCESSCODE_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget -qO- http://localhost:3210/ || exit 1'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
